state:
**Goal `ldap`, Stage 10 (the feature proofs) is under way.** Stages 1 to 5 and 7 to 9 are done; Stage 4 lacks only a CA a program supplies, and Stage 6 lacks only wiring the schema into the readers. `Core\Ldap` and `Core\Ldap\Filter` owe nothing: every `Filter` member has an `about.md`, three examples, an attack, a bench with a recorded figure in `docs/perf/members.ndjson`, and a `covers:` marker on a Rust test.

**A filter nests at most 100 levels** (`rule:core-classes/ldap-filter-is-a-value`, `nvs_ldap::MAX_FILTER_DEPTH`). The `not` attack found that a filter nested in a loop overflowed the stack in `toString`; `not`, `all`, `any` and `parse` now throw `LogicError` past the limit, and `Filter::from_ber` and `Filter::depth_of` stop there.

**How proofs run with no server**, on `Core\Mail::send`'s footing: the root `nvs.toml` has an `[ldap.corp]` block at `ldaps://127.0.0.1:1`, a closed port, and one `[[app]] entry` per proof program that needs a grant. The value classes need no grant and no block: their examples print what `toString` or a reader returns. `Connection`, `Entries`, `Entry` and `Changes` need a live connection, and no example can get one at a closed port: that needs a decision (see Backlog) before their proofs are written.

The Rust side of a value class's proofs is a `// covers:` line above a test in `crates/nvs-stdlib/tests/ldap.rs` (comma-separated names are fine); an instance member also needs one in a `.nvst` case, at the end of the `--FILE--` block so no line number moves.

items.text: **`Core\Ldap\Dn`'s members owe nothing** (`rule:testing/feature-proofs`): `about.md`, three examples, one attack and one bench each, a `covers:` marker on a Rust test, and on a `.nvst` case for each instance member. Registry rows at `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/ldap/registry.rs:1888`. `docs/examples/core/Ldap-Filter/` is the model for the shape, and `nvs fmt` runs over the new directories before the first bless (playbook).
**`Core\Ldap\Sid` and `Core\Ldap\Ad` owe nothing**, the same proofs, rows at `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/ldap/registry.rs:2066` and `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/ldap/registry.rs:2192`.

backlog: `Connection`, `Entries`, `Entry` and `Changes` examples need a live directory; the choice (a `// requires:` marker that skips them without Samba, or a skip entry in `data/proofs/policy.json` with its reason) is the user's — `rule:testing/feature-proofs`.
`nv try` does not apply an `[[app]]` grant from the root `nvs.toml`, so a probe of a granted member needs `nv proofs --bless` instead (`tools/nv/cmd/try.ts`).
Stage 4: a CA a program supplies to `Ldap::open` (`docs/agent/goals/ldap.md`).
Stage 6: wiring the schema into the readers (`crates/nvs-ldap/src/schema.rs`).
